conditions.event_K: maximum even event order; polynomial degree K+1
conditions.compiler: Qiskit1.3.0 rz/sx/x/cx opt1 seed17 no topology/routing override
conditions.state_reference: same saved raw ray/full-H reference and exact common norm; no regeneration or renormalization

adaptive_rules.H6_S1024: After initial K2 s128/256/512: add K2 s1024 iff s512 is the finite-G exploration minimum for any epsilon OR its difference from the minimum is <=2 combined SE. Do not assert global optimality if the best remains at the upper boundary.
adaptive_rules.H6_K4: At a currently lowest or <=2combinedSE K2 r among16/32/64/128, add same-r K4 only if any epsilon is bias-ineligible/width-ambiguous OR (abs(signed_bias)+u)>=5%epsilon_axis OR Hybrid/RTE difference<=2combinedSE. Record the trigger before the batch. At most four K4 candidates; no unconditional K4 grid.
adaptive_rules.H4_S256: Add s256 K2/K4 only if s128 improves any corresponding epsilon over stored s64, is <=2combinedSE from s64, changes the observed Hybrid/RTE order, or the new Hybrid/RTE comparison is <=2combinedSE. If s128 is clearly worse and order unchanged in all relevant cells, stop H4.
adaptive_rules.ambiguity: No computable comparator or finite allowance: retain unresolved. No treating null as0/infinity; no forced scientific ranking.
adaptive_rules.stop: Stop after decrease-to-increase trend is resolved for relevant epsilons, H4 clear worsening without changed order, no material scientific value, source/numerical mismatch, or the finite candidate cap. Only the listed 12 candidate universe is allowed.

H4.early_stop: No WIDTH_AMBIGUITY in the five existing precision decisions; never repeat a completed precision unnecessarily
H4.backend: fixed d3fdfad FLINT mean-matrix/vector contraction path

H6.unresolved_policy: Keep ambiguity; no new numerical model/allowance/threshold or state retry

pricing.confirmation_nomination: Freeze union of per-epsilon new RTE exploration minima before confirmation. Add already-sampled adjacent-s candidates only when their <=2combinedSE difference prevents locating the empirical minimum/turning trend; freeze these IDs before their confirmation. No old successful cohort rerun.
pricing.confirmation_extension: Extend a new candidate only when its G difference from fixed saved Hybrid or adjacent sampled RTE is <=2combinedSE AND nominal t95 halfwidth>1%G AND its own uncertainty exceeds the saved comparator floor. At384 keep near-tie/unresolved. No repeated old successful confirmations.
pricing.cohorts: No exploration/confirmation pooling. Frozen-nominee result and post-confirmation-set min remain distinct. Same trajectory supplies both axes; use paired covariance; five eps share prices.
pricing.seeds: Existing H4 [20261025,3101,L_D,q,r,K,tag,index] and H6 [20261025,6,L_D,q,r,K,tag,index]; exploration101/confirmation202; fresh r>8 candidate IDs, no unused-index or old-cohort replay assumption without checking.

comparisons.primary: Finite sampled RTE family versus saved independently confirmed Hybrid, per molecule/epsilon. Reuse s64 and lower baselines without reranking before execution permission.
comparisons.matched: Only quote existing exact q/r/K matched controls. No new Hybrid r>8 is in scope, so matched Hybrid at new r16/32/64/128 is unavailable/null; do not label these family comparisons matched.

provenance: Before each permitted scientific batch freeze exact IDs, SOURCE/code/runtime/input, seeds/index ranges, call counts and stop. Use a fresh driver/output; never reopen old fixed CLI output or STOP. This disabled preparation plan remains unchanged.
resources: Choose workers/memory from actual free resources and workload; no arbitrary CPU/RAM caps or shared/other-user modifications. Matrix-free H6; native FLINT H4. Do not treat s=q*r as sufficient to discard actual q/r/seed/phase/compiler provenance.
expected_outputs: log-s log-G figure with saved Hybrid baselines
technical report, SOURCE/input/raw/native preservation, commit/remote SHA
approval: User chat permission is sufficient after review of this concrete scope; no approval certificate or grant machinery. Preparation stops awaiting that permission.
technical_retry_policy: User permits correcting unintended technical interruptions and limited fresh attempts. Preserve failed evidence/SOURCE; never repeat successful science, alter scientific conditions, or exceed total limits. Old STOPs stay closed.
